Profile avatar with initial letter and green checkmark
Bio textarea is editable
Contact section with email and phone inputs
Location section with city and state inputs
Social Profiles card with platform selector, Instagram and YouTube handles with fetch buttons
Metrics cards showing Followers, Engagement, Avg Likes, Score
Classification dropdowns: Industry, Tier, Gender, Audience Focus, Content Types

Quick Actions: Create Payment, Edit Rate Card

=== HISTORY TAB ===
Activity Timeline with chronological events (Deals, Gifts)

=== HEADER ACTIONS ===

Outreach button (data-testid='send-outreach-btn') opens modal

Save button (data-testid='save-changes-btn') - disabled when no changes, enabled when modified

Modal title: Send Outreach to Priya Fashion
Channel selector: Email (default), WhatsApp
Template quick buttons: Collaboration, Follow Up, Campaign Invite, Custom
Subject input field
Message textarea

Save button disabled initially (no changes)
Save button enabled after making changes
Clicking Save persists changes to API
Success toast 'Changes saved!' appears
=== REGRESSION: PUBLICATION DETAIL PAGE ===
Publication Detail Page still works correctly
5 tabs: Overview, Journalists, Outreach, Coverage, Paid PR
Tab navigation works correctly
